title: Dungeon Universalis
subtitle: The definitive tactical dungeon crawler and modular tabletop RPG sandbox across Arasca
tagline: Forge your legend in a living, boundless fantasy realm
loreSummary: Step into the vast continent of Arasca, a perilous medieval fantasy world brimming with subterranean dungeons, ancient ruins, warring factions, and mythical creatures. Whether exploring solo, cooperatively against the Artificial Dark Player, or facing a human adversary, your band of heroes will travel overland, acquire lost artifacts, and decide the fate of nations.
keyFeatures: Unrivaled tactical depth combining 1980s-90s golden-age dungeon crawling with modern Euro-game precision
Deep character progression with dozens of races, classes, skills, spells, and persistent travel equipment
Dynamic overland exploration with random travel events, settlements, quests, and evolving reputation
Multiple game modes: 100% cooperative with AI Dark Player, competitive 1-vs-many, or full tabletop RPG

dun_raazbal_campaign.name: The Return of Raazbal Campaign (20 Quests)
dun_raazbal_campaign.description: The core epic narrative campaign traversing the continent of Arasca from introductory skirmishes to the final showdown against Raazbal.

dun_regional_campaigns.name: Regional Chronicles (The Shiang & Greenskin Threat)
dun_regional_campaigns.description: A focused 10-quest saga combining the two official mini-campaigns from Quest Book I: the 4-quest Far East dynasty arc and the 6-quest frontier defense.

dun_grand_saga.name: Complete Arasca Trilogy (30 Quests)
dun_grand_saga.description: The comprehensive Quest Book I experience uniting The Return of Raazbal, The Shiang, and The Greenskin Threat into one sweeping persistent adventure.

dun_completionist_chronicles.name: Master of Dungeons & Epic Events (42 Quests)
dun_completionist_chronicles.description: The ultimate sandbox campaign: all 30 narrative campaign quests plus major independent legendary quests and high-stakes epic events across Arasca.

milestones.title: The Gathering Shadows
milestones.phase: Act I - The Whispers of Arasca (Quests M1–M5)
milestones.description: Rescue captive merchants, investigate Rorg's lair, and unearth ancient catacombs as the dread conspiracy begins to surface.

milestones.title: Infiltration & The Beast
milestones.phase: Act II - Trials of the Frontier (Quests M6–M10)
milestones.description: Survive the deadly spider caverns, infiltrate the fortress of Thorzul, execute a daring prison break, and hunt down a monstrous behemoth.

milestones.title: Relics of the Ancients
milestones.description: Delve into the crypt of the accursed king, protect the regional governor, reactivate forgotten magical portals, and claim the fabled Gem of Courage.

milestones.title: The Fall of Raazbal
milestones.phase: Climax - Siege of the Rock Tower (Quests M16–M20)
milestones.description: Eliminate dark infiltrators, penetrate the formidable Rock Tower, and vanquish the ancient evil Raazbal in a climactic duel for Arasca.
